propositions: Cloud's AcliClient.update_issue with assignee=None or assignee="" must call unassign_issue exactly once and route to REST API /rest/api/3/issue/<key>/assignee with {"accountId": null} without spawning an ACLI subprocess

When update_issue co-submits an empty assignee with an editable field (e.g. summary), unassign_issue fires once and the workitem edit argv contains the editable flag but omits the --assignee flag entirely
A non-empty assignee value in update_issue must NOT call unassign_issue and must include the normalized --assignee flag in the ACLI subprocess argv
New test file test_cloud_unassign_6a74.py mirrors DC test sibling test_dc_unassign_751e.py with positive assertions capturing the real REST request production path rather than stubbed method calls
